title: Hairy Iopas
html_source: The citizen compares William Field with “long-haired” Iopas, a character from Virgil’s Aenid, who sings, drinks and plays his lyre. Field frequently sang in Blackrock Townhall to aid charitable causes, and had a bard’s harp in his coat of arms.
